goal: Ship the full loop — contract, bind, brief, fan out, gate, verify, document, account — with the package never calling a model.

in: MCP tools for every loop command
the skill that drives the loop inside Claude Code
unit tests for contract validation, briefing, waves, acceptance and cost
an end-to-end shell matrix for the loop
out: spawning worker processes — the host spawns, the package briefs
authoring contracts — the agent authors, the package validates
counting real tokens — no tokenizer ships, estimates are labelled

decisions.subject: model calls inside the package
decisions.value: no file in the package may call a model or open a network connection; enforced by a test
decisions.rationale: the one defensible sentence is that agreement is decided by comparison, never by a model — if authoring moves inside the package that stops being true

decisions.subject: cli flag for selecting a contract
decisions.rationale: every loop command takes it, so it has to be the same word everywhere

decisions.subject: cli command that runs acceptance checks
decisions.rationale: verify already means route verification in v0.1 and renaming it would break installed users

decisions.subject: how token figures are presented
decisions.value: every token figure is labelled an estimate and states its chars-per-token assumption
decisions.rationale: the package measures bytes; calling bytes tokens would be the kind of unsourced number this project exists to avoid

decisions.subject: mcp tool name prefix for loop tools
decisions.value: no prefix; tool names are write_contract, bind_contract, brief_unit, fleet_plan, run_acceptance, generate_docs, cost_report
decisions.rationale: the existing five tools carry no prefix, and mixing conventions inside one server is the drift this tool exists to catch

units.goal: Expose every loop command as an MCP tool, matching the naming decision, refusing bad contracts with the validator's own messages.
units.notes: The SDK is an optional peer loaded by dynamic import. Keep that pattern.

units.goal: Rewrite SKILL.md so a Claude Code agent can run the whole loop: author a contract to the schema, bind it, brief each unit, fan out one subagent per unit, gate their decisions, accept, document.
Unit tests for contract validation rejections, brief content, wave ordering, acceptance running and cost reporting.
Rewrite README.md around the loop without losing the v0.1 pitch that the gate is the product.
Extend the shell matrix to cover the loop end to end, including a contract that is correctly rejected.

acceptance.statement: the MCP server lists every loop tool and starts cleanly
SKILL.md documents the loop in order
acceptance.check: test -f SKILL.md && grep -q 'spec --schema' SKILL.md && grep -q 'bind --contract' SKILL.md && grep -q 'brief --contract' SKILL.md && grep -q 'accept --contract' SKILL.md && ! grep -q 'verify --contract' SKILL.md
test -f test/contract.test.js && test -f test/run.test.js && node --test test/*.test.js

acceptance.statement: the README covers the loop and keeps the gate pitch
acceptance.check: test -f README.md && grep -q 'spec --schema' README.md && grep -q 'refus' README.md && grep -q -i 'estimate' README.md
